title: Mass Tree Exterminator
kicker: Farming Simulator 25 mod: a whole wood gone in one click

thumbnail.text: Clear a wood in one click

hand.do: Go to some trees on your own land
hand.why: Get out of any vehicle first. Walking there is not in the video.

caption.heading: Your wood lot
caption.text: Every tree on your land, one by one, takes ages to clear.

hand.do: Shift+P, then Landscaping > Mass Tree Exterminator
Click one corner of the area, then the opposite corner
hand.why: Red markers show the trees that go

caption.heading: Mark the area
caption.text: Two clicks: the trees that go get a red marker; the count and cost show at the cursor.

hand.do: Click once more (Bulldoze area), then Yes

caption.heading: One click, one bill
caption.text: Confirm once: every tree, stump and bush in it goes.

caption.heading: Cleared
caption.text: At the bulldozer's own price per tree. Trees on other people's land stay.

hand.do: Press ESC to leave the construction menu
